abilities.name: Dragon Practice
notes:
Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack if the target dies while the initial missile is in flight.
  - This happens even if the target dies to Super Scorcher Breath burn, giving him a total of 2 stacks.

abilities.name: Super Scorcher Breath

evidence.quote: Active: Smolder spits a fireball at the target enemy that deals physical damage, increased by critical strike damage (based on critical strike chance); applies on-hit effects; applies life steal at 50% effectiveness; and triggers on-attack effects.
The explosion benefits from life steal at 50% effectiveness and applies on-hit effects.
The bolts benefit from life steal at 50% effectiveness and apply on-hit effects.

execute.quote: Enemy champions afflicted with the burn are also executed once Smolder deals damage to them that would leave them below 6.5% of their maximum health.

notes:
Only Smolder's damage counts for triggering the execute.
  - If the target is below the threshold while afflicted with the burn, they will be executed on the next instance of damage dealt by Smolder, which includes the burn tick.
If Super Scorcher Breath would damage the target to below the execution threshold, they are executed on the same damage instance.

Super Scorcher Breath's initial fireball, explosion and extra bolts can all be blocked and dodged.
  - The application of the burn is negated in all cases.

abilities.name: Achooo!

evidence.quote: Active: Smolder sneezes a fiery glob in the target direction that deals physical damage to enemies hit and slows them by 35% for 1.5 seconds, slowing down in missile speed after travelling 1200 units.

notes: Spell shield can block either the glob or the explosion, but not both.
